act.name: Wild Life (Protection) Act, 1972
act.source_authority: Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change, Government of India
act.description: Central law protecting wild animals, birds and plants and governing protected areas, trade and wildlife offences.

sections.title: Prohibition of hunting.
sections.text: Section 9 prohibits hunting of protected wild animals except as permitted by the Act; consult the linked official text for the complete provision.
sections.plain_language_summary: Hunting protected wild animals is prohibited except in the limited circumstances authorised by the Act.
